title: People who text your Twilio number get a reply that says 'Accepted'
symptoms: Sender gets a reply containing Accepted or another raw response body
cause: Twilio treats the incoming-message webhook's response as TwiML. A webhook that answers with plain text, such as a workflow tool's default Accepted, sends that text back to the sender.
fix: Respond to the webhook at once with an empty TwiML document and do the processing after that.
apply: HTTP 200, Content-Type: text/xml, body: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Response></Response>
